# Quotation -- Technical maintenance services, Rautavaara industrial estate (TKR-RFQ-2026-07)

**Bidder:** Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 2. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification (LVI- ja sahkourakointi) and a valid F-gas regulation qualification. The company employs 62 LVI professionals (requirement: 20+) and 48 electrical professionals (requirement: 15+) in its own workforce. A current Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate is held. The qualifying reference project is the Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue framework agreement, EUR 1,650,000 (2021-2024), exceeding the EUR 300,000 threshold in 2.5.

## 3. Technical requirements

**3.1 Occupational safety plan:** Managed under our occupational safety management system, covering site induction and permit-to-work procedures across the multi-tenant estate.

**3.2 Warranty period:** Standard warranty offered on installed equipment and materials for the maintenance period.

**3.3 Lift maintenance:** Statutory inspection and maintenance obligations for goods and passenger lifts met and documented through our lift-service arrangement.

**3.4 Waste management:** Waste generated during maintenance work sorted and managed per site requirements.

**3.5 Spare parts:** Common parts sourced through our established supplier network; discontinued equipment assessed for equivalent substitution.

**3.6 Quality control:** Internal inspection and sign-off procedures applied to all completed work.

**3.7 Environmental management:** Environmental impacts during works managed under our environmental management system.

**3.8 Building envelope inspection:** Condition of roofing, cladding and building fabric assessed across the four buildings on a scheduled basis.

**3.9 Maintenance visit scheduling:** Visit content and frequency set per system and building, agreed with the estate manager.

**3.10 Access and security:** Site-access and security procedures observed across all tenanted buildings, per each tenant's own arrangements.

**3.11 Reporting:** Maintenance activity and outstanding items reported to the Buyer's facilities contact on a regular basis.

**3.12 Response and on-call:** Response tiered by fault severity, with out-of-hours cover for critical shared-system faults.

**3.13 Asset register handover:** Existing asset register and documentation received and maintained going forward.

**3.14 Corrective maintenance response:** Non-emergency requests addressed within an agreed working timeframe by severity.

**3.15 Staff training:** Training provided to the Buyer's facilities staff on maintained systems.

**3.16 Subcontracting management:** Subcontracted trades selected and supervised against our internal standards.

**3.17 Escalation:** Unresolved faults escalated internally if the agreed response time is exceeded, with the Buyer kept informed.

## 4. Commercial terms

**4.1 Bonus-malus:** Arrangement proposed for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels, set out in the pricing schedule.
**4.2 Price indexation:** Annual adjustment against an agreed index, reference month confirmed at signature.
**4.3 Payment terms:** As set out in this request and its annexes, accepted.
**4.4 Invoicing:** Monthly, electronic invoicing capability confirmed.
**4.5 Termination:** 30 days' written notice for uncured material breach.
**4.6 Pricing structure:** Shared-system maintenance priced strictly in **EUR per square metre per year**, per Liite B.3 -- not per month.
**4.7 Currency:** All prices in euro.

## 5. Enclosures

Reference form (Liite 2), certificate of pension insurance payments, certificate of tax payment, description of the quality system.

## 6. Format

Minimum 11pt font. Delivery channel and number of copies stated separately in the covering note. Closing date and time noted: 16 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable). Framework pricing expressed in euro. All monetary figures rounded to two decimal places.

## Annex A

Personnel qualifications and site-induction requirements confirmed. Method statement provided for installation work minimising disruption to tenants. F-gas-regulated maintenance confirmed for refrigeration equipment. HVAC maintenance scope set out per building. Continuity of service addressed through cross-trained staff. Periodic electrical inspection programme confirmed. Fire protection testing scheduled per building. Access to tenanted areas observes the 48-hour notice period stated in this annex, except in emergencies.

## Annex B

**B.1 Discount structure:** Proposed as order volumes increase, set out in the pricing schedule.
**B.2 Penalty clause:** Contractual penalty for service-level shortfall accepted in principle.
**B.3 Pricing unit:** Shared-system maintenance priced at EUR per square metre per year, confirmed as required, not EUR per month. Prices valid 90 days from the closing date.
